name: Shinjin Seiyuu Ayumi no Afureko wa Cosplay Gachi Hame H ~Kageki Engi Shidou de Honki no Kaikan Voice Shuuroku Chuu!~
original_name: 新人声優あゆみのアフレコはコスプレガチハメH～カゲキ演技指導で本気の快感ボイス収録中！～
source:
In her small apartment, a lone young girl stared at her screen.
Her name was Ayumi. She was an aspiring voice actress.
She'd posted herself on Net Seiyuu, and finally got 1 email.
"Aa--! Is this work? Did I get work!?"
Thrilled by the chance she agreed to terms, but only too late realized it was for an eroge!

Ayumi had zero experience with erotic game voice acting.
She was in over her head, and the director knew it. But together
they cooperated to tease out her dramatic spirit.
As Ayumi finds her real, sexual voice, it's decided she'll debut on stage in real time.
What does tomorrow hold for the rising star!? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE095024.html]DLSite English[/url]]
